summary: Completed Module 02 BREAK: Diagnosed Log Injection (CRLF Log Forging) and forensic log tampering
evidence: Identified log forgery mechanism: User 'bob' injected a newline character (\n) and crafted JSON payload inside the 'url' parameter of request r-101
Surfaced forensic evidence: The fake 'admin login' event (r-102) was nested directly inside the string value of the 'url' field rather than emitted as a distinct log record
Exposed timeline paradox: Injected event claimed a timestamp of 15:42:03.500Z, whereas the enclosing request r-101 completed earlier at 15:42:03.420Z
Defined defense strategy: Sanitize CRLF control characters (\r, \n), enforce strict schema validation on URL inputs, and rely on strict JSON serializer escaping to neutralize log injection attacks
